rows.T_domain_basis: nine-point NIST-JANAF liquid-standard-state regression at 100 K spacing
rows.janaf_range_caveat: Below fusion, the explicit JANAF (l) table is a metastable-liquid standard state; no crystal value or fabricated fusion correction is used.
rows.derivation: 2 MgO(l) + SiO2(l) = Mg2SiO4(l); all reference states are explicit JANAF (l), p°=0.1 MPa. At each T, delta_rG°=G°compound-sum(nu_i G°parent_i), log10K=-delta_rG°/(R T ln10), then least-squares fit against 1/T.

rows.source_compilation: Ihsan Barin, Thermochemical Data of Pure Substances, 3rd ed. (1995), Vol. I
rows.source_tables: Co2SiO4 p.546; CoO p.543; SiO2(l) NIST-JANAF Si-013 inherited from EXT-1 parent set
rows.T_domain_basis: four-point central-table liquid-standard-state regression at 100 K spacing
rows.phase_basis: Co2SiO4 explicit liquid; CoO metastable liquid below fusion from tabled crystal+fusion data
rows.metastable_liquid_construction: At Tm=2078 K, Barin gives H_liq=-77.924 kJ/mol, S_liq=189.873 J/(mol K), Cp_liq=60.668 J/(mol K), and deltaHfus=54.392 kJ/mol. H_liq(T)=H_liq(Tm)+Cp_liq(T-Tm)/1000; S_liq(T)=S_liq(Tm)+Cp_liq ln(T/Tm); G_liq=H_liq-T S_liq/1000. Unit check: J/(mol K)*K/1000=kJ/mol. Delta_fG_liq=Delta_fG_cr+[G_liq-G_cr], since elemental references cancel.
rows.derivation: At each T, delta_rG=delta_fG[Co2SiO4(l)]-2 delta_fG[CoO(l)]-delta_fG[SiO2(l)]; log10K=-delta_rG/(R T ln10); least-squares fit log10K=A+B/T.

errata: K2SiO3 is not fitted because NIST-JANAF has no K2O(l) parent table.
Na4SiO4 is index-only and K4SiO4 is absent in the bounded central set; neither orthosilicate is activated.
Mn/Ni/Zn silicate liquid table bodies were not held. Co2SiO4 is the sole v2 addition, from Barin p.546 with CoO p.543.
The research-only 9-parent/39-row pack bypasses the intentionally fixed 8-parent/38-row public loader by direct ImccDatapack construction. No production identity or loader behavior is changed.
